info.title: Smarter.Poker Public AI Agent API
info.description: Public, machine-readable API for autonomous AI agents, LLMs, and poker players to query verified poker venues, live rooms, tournament series, and schedules nationwide.

get.summary: Search Poker Venues and Card Rooms
get.description: Returns verified poker venues filtered by state, city, name, or keyword query.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search term matching venue name, city, address, or brand.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Two-letter US state code (e.g., NV, CA, TX, FL).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 20, max 100).

200.description: List of matching poker venues with location and contact metadata.

get.summary: Get Detailed Poker Venue Information
get.description: Retrieves comprehensive information about a single poker venue, including address, phone, amenities, social card image, and canonical URL.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique numeric or string ID of the venue.

200.description: Detailed venue profile.

get.summary: Search Poker Tournament Series and Festivals
get.description: Returns upcoming, ongoing, and past major poker tournament series across WSOP, WPT, MSPT, RGPS, and independent festivals.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search term matching tour, series name, or host casino.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of series to return (default 20, max 100).

200.description: List of matching poker tournament series.

post.summary: Model Context Protocol JSON-RPC 2.0 Tool Execution
post.description: Executes Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool calls including calculate_poker_odds, get_preflop_chart, calculate_icm_payouts, get_poker_term_definition, search_poker_venues, and search_tournament_series.

200.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 tool execution result with structured data and web citations.

get.summary: MCP Server Capabilities and SSE Transport
get.description: Returns active MCP server capabilities or establishes a Server-Sent Events (SSE) connection with ?transport=sse.

200.description: Server metadata or active SSE event stream.

default.summary: Verified Smarter.Poker MCP Server Discovery Response

get.summary: Calculate Multiway Poker Equity and Odds
get.description: Calculates exact and Monte Carlo hand equity, win probabilities, and tie probabilities for Texas Hold'em and Omaha (PLO-4, PLO-5, PLO-6).

parameters.name: game
parameters.description: Poker game variant: nlhe, plo4, plo5, plo6.

200.description: Calculated equity percentages with citation URL.

get.summary: Get GTO Preflop Opening Ranges
get.description: Returns solver-calculated 6-Max 100BB GTO opening frequencies for UTG, MP, HJ, CO, BTN, or SB.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Table position: UTG, MP, HJ, CO, BTN, SB.

200.description: GTO opening frequencies and interactive range matrix link.

get.summary: Calculate Tournament ICM Dollar Equity
get.description: Computes Malmuth-Harville Independent Chip Model (ICM) tournament equity payouts from player chip stacks.

200.description: ICM dollar equity per player with citation URL.

get.summary: Lookup Authoritative Poker Terminology
get.description: Returns verified poker definitions, GTO acronyms, and live room rules from the official glossary.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Poker term or jargon query (e.g. straddle, pot odds, icm, 3-bet).

200.description: Matching glossary definitions, related terms, and canonical links.

get.summary: Retrieve Daily $2,000 Freerolls & Diamond Freerolls Schedule
get.description: Provides the upcoming Daily $2,000 Freeroll tournaments schedule, formats, prize values, and entry criteria.

parameters.name: tier
parameters.description: Filter by tournament tier: all, open, or diamond.

200.description: Daily freeroll schedule, guarantees, tier rules, and registration links.

get.summary: Get Poker Bankroll and Form W-2G Tax Ledger Specifications
get.description: Returns specifications for Form W-2G gambling tax tracking, receipt photo attachments, and CPA Schedule C CSV exports.

200.description: Bankroll and tax documentation specifications.

get.summary: Get Poker Dealer Toke Tracker and Shift Management Specifications
get.description: Returns specifications for poker dealer toke tracking, cash vs. tournament downs, hourly rates, and casino shift scheduling.

200.description: Dealer toke and down tracking specifications.

get.summary: Get PokerBrain and Jarvis AI Coaching Specifications
get.description: Returns capabilities for street-by-street plain English hand reviews, automated leak detection, and GTO solver baselines.

200.description: PokerBrain AI coaching capabilities.

get.summary: Get Virtual Poker Table Sandbox Specifications
get.description: Returns virtual table simulation capabilities, custom scenario builders, and multi-street runout distributions.

200.description: Virtual sandbox simulation specifications.

get.summary: Get Club Commander Live Room Management Specifications
get.description: Returns card room waitlist specifications, digital TV board specs, tournament clocks, and dealer rotation features.

200.description: Club Commander live room management specifications.

get.summary: Get Club Arena Private Poker Clubs & Union Hosting Specifications
get.description: Returns private poker club hosting specifications, multi-club union infrastructure, ring game structures, MTT configs, and cashier hierarchies.

parameters.name: feature
parameters.description: Feature category (ring_games, tournaments, unions, cashiers, all).

200.description: Club Arena private club and union specifications.

get.summary: Get Poker Reels & Social Feed Specifications
get.description: Returns poker short-form video reels specifications, social media feed dynamics, creator diamond rewards, and hand history tagging.

200.description: Poker Reels and social network specifications.

get.summary: Get Video Library & Interactive Coaching Specifications
get.description: Returns video library masterclass specifications, course structures, mid-hand pause quiz mechanics, and syllabus data.

200.description: Video Library and coaching specifications.

get.summary: Search & Retrieve GTO Poker Strategy Lessons
get.description: Returns complete poker strategy lessons, answer-first summaries, mathematical tables, and training drill links from the 40-lesson Smarter.Poker curriculum.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query or lesson slug (e.g. pot-odds, 3-bet, icm, button-opening-range).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Lesson category filter (Preflop, Postflop, Math, Tournaments, Cash, Bankroll, Mental Game, Theory).

200.description: GTO strategy curriculum lessons and structured content.

get.summary: Get Verified Software & Cardroom Comparisons
get.description: Returns verified, source-cited side-by-side comparison matrices and best-of benchmarks between Smarter.Poker and named competitors.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Comparison slug (e.g. best-poker-club-apps, best-gto-poker-trainers, best-poker-bankroll-trackers, best-poker-room-management-software).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keyword search across all 16 verified comparisons.

200.description: Verified competitor comparison matrix and primary sources.

get.summary: Get Poker Trivia and Brain Training Specifications
get.description: Returns capabilities for multiplayer poker trivia, 10,000+ question bank, Survival mode, Blitz Time Attack, and GTO math drills.

200.description: Poker trivia and brain training specifications.

get.summary: Get GTO Training Games and Decision Drill Specifications
get.description: Returns specifications for 100+ interactive scenarios, solver accuracy grading, and multi-street decision branching.

200.description: GTO training games specifications.

get.summary: Get Home Poker Games Directory Specifications
get.description: Returns specifications for verified home game discovery, host safety standards, blind structures, and SMS waitlists.

200.description: Home poker games directory specifications.

get.summary: Get Poker Messenger and WebRTC Calling Specifications
get.description: Returns specifications for live WebRTC video table calling, spatial voice chat, and social poker messaging.

200.description: Poker messenger and video calling specifications.

get.summary: Unified Schema.org JSON-LD Entity & Knowledge Graph
get.description: Returns the complete interlinked Schema.org @graph for Smarter.Poker including Organization, WebSite, 15 SoftwareApplication verticals, Dataset directories, DefinedTermSet, CollectionPages, and Research Reports.

200.description: JSON-LD @graph document.

get.summary: Multilingual AI Grounding Corpus (EN, ES, PT, DE, FR)
get.description: Returns localized summaries of all 15 Smarter.Poker verticals, tools, and directories in English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, and French.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: ISO language code (en, es, pt, de, fr).

200.description: Localized AI grounding corpus.

get.summary: AI Crawler Classification & Grounding Corpus Health
get.description: Classifies incoming AI bot User-Agents and returns real-time counts of lessons, starting hands, glossary terms, comparisons, research reports, and MCP tools.

200.description: Crawler attribution and corpus inventory.
